approvalPolicy.selection: Maximum development pessimistic average R; ties resolved N, shorter horizon, lower target, stop nearest 1 ATR
approvalPolicy.entry: First strictly later pinned H4 open; completed pre-entry H4 Wilder ATR14
approvalPolicy.cohort: Each recipe uses only cases with a complete valid 60-H4 path; every shorter candidate is projected from that same path
approvalPolicy.ordering: Opening gaps first; same-H4 SL/TP order remains ambiguous; selector scores ambiguity as stop-first but does not relabel it
approvalPolicy.review: Exact fixed-H4 v1 baseline matched on the same complete 60-H4 cohort; development-selected contract is distinct, positive, and improves pessimistic average gross R in both development and reused holdout; reused holdout is also positive.
